summary: C++ vector renderer for SVG and Lottie
use_when: Render SVG or Lottie assets natively without a browser runtime
Use CPU or GPU backends for vector playback in a native application
avoid_when: Use Chromium capture for scenes that depend on DOM, CSS or browser APIs
Use resvg when you only need deterministic rasterisation of a static SVG

assessment.rationale: C++ vector engine supports SVG and Lottie, including CPU and GPU backends. MIT; native library/build route. Lottie feature coverage varies by spec.
